versions.content: On reception of request for DM 0 4 (call of J1939Dcm_RequestIndication with parameter requestedPgn set according Table column “PGN (Hexadecimal)”) the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall use the common sequence of chapter “ 7.6.2 FreezeFrame ” with the parameters ‘ FreezeFrameKind’ set to ‘ DEM_J1939DCM_FREEZEFRAME ’ .
